integrity.computational_checks: two optional finite stress-test programs, not an infinite proof
integrity.proof_scope: all integer n >= 2k >= 6 and all distinct marked k-sets

scientific_limitations: No identification claim among unrestricted finite graphs; only the orbit partition within a named Johnson graph.
Only two distinct individually distinguished vertices and n >= 2k >= 6 are treated; the known J(n,2) case is excluded.
The k+1 refinement bound need not be sharp, and prior specialized pointed-Johnson literature may contain equivalent statements.
title: Two marked vertices recover Johnson-graph automorphism orbits
